decision: A new, angular black-and-orange sci-fi cargo case for provisional non-colliding decoration, viewed at player height from all sides. The matching blackandorangenewshape.png is the design reference and the user-selected TRELLIS GLB is a 3D reference. A 9,000-triangle reduction kept the silhouette but fractured its panels, so the delivery is a clean hard-surface rebuild with a sloped armored roof, broad white waist band and central side frame, orange diagonal lower armor, top rails and orange end hatch. The user requested a glossy finish: dark graphite, orange lacquer and polished chrome use low roughness and metallic atlas values. This is separate from the earlier rectangular black-and-orange case. Approximate 4.46-stud height and decoration role await visual approval.
